entries.01526cf2f1c7a1cf: A division that develops, manufactures and sells CNC systems (CNC and servo motors), which control machine tools through numerical control, and lasers, and provides maintenance services. Positioned as FANUC CORPORATION's core technology, the company explains that “CNC and servo motors are used in all products.” Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥208,478 million (up 7.0% year on year), accounting for 24.3%. The company states that demand in the machine tool industry, the main customer for CNC systems, was weak in Europe but performed well in Japan, India and China.
entries.05e77721b62391e2: The company provides CNC systems and servo motors that drive machine tools under numerical control, lasers, industrial robots and robot systems, and ROBODRILL, ROBOSHOT and ROBOCUT, which apply CNC technology, and also provides maintenance services. The company states that it develops products that are “unbreakable,” “notify before breaking” and “can be repaired immediately even if broken,” aiming to minimize customers’ downtime and improve operating rates. R&D expenses for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥44,959 million. Across all product groups of FA, robots and robomachines, the company advanced development of more practical AI functions, and in the robot field it advanced open-platform support, including the release of drivers for the open-source ROS 2 and the development of Python execution functions.
entries.071298362114749b: A division that develops, manufactures and sells industrial robots and robot systems incorporating robots, and provides maintenance services.
entries.1567ab59a21006e5: The division that makes machine tools themselves by applying CNC system technology; it develops, manufactures and sells the Robodrill (small cutting machine), Roboshot (electric injection molding machine) and Robocut (wire electrical discharge machine), and provides maintenance services. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥129.6 billion (down 5.8% from the previous fiscal year), a share of 15.1%. The Roboshot SC series developed during the fiscal year, which expanded the basic specifications of the clamping unit and redesigned the toggle mechanism, won the main award of the 68th Nikkan Kogyo Shimbun Ten Major New Products Award.
entries.194d5ff7340e8a42: A division that provides maintenance services for FANUC CORPORATION products worldwide.
entries.19cff86f450effe1: A division that provides maintenance services for FANUC CORPORATION products worldwide. Based on its origins as a supplier of production goods, the company states that it will continue to provide maintenance services for as long as customers continue to use FANUC CORPORATION products. Under the slogan “Service First,” the company explains that it sought to strengthen its service structure with an emphasis on IT-enabled customer experience. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥141,143 million (up 4.4% year on year), accounting for 16.5%.
entries.437615d6596473e1: Ordinary profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥227,485 million (up 15.6% year on year), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥166,543 million (up 12.9%). The company explains that, amid many uncertain factors including geopolitical risks, the impact of tariffs imposed by the US government, and exchange rate fluctuations, all departments, including R&D, plants, sales, service and administration, worked on expanding sales and reducing expenses. All funds required during the period were covered by internal funds, and no external financing was raised.

entries.963cb6820cde407b: A division that develops, manufactures and sells industrial robots and robot systems incorporating robots, and provides maintenance services. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥378,610 million (up 14.9% year on year), accounting for 44.1% of total consolidated revenue, making it the largest of the four product divisions. During the current period, the company developed the R-2000/E Series, a full model change of the large R-2000 series robot; the CRX-3iA, a collaborative robot with a mechanical unit weight of 11 kg that can be carried in one hand; the M-810/190-20B machining robot, which can be used for machining large parts such as automotive giga-castings; and the SR-9iA/R, a shelf-type SCARA robot. The company explains that in Japan, revenue from the automotive industry declined, while in China, EV-related and general industry sales performed well.

Orders received in the same period were ¥883,467 million (up 11.0% year on year), and production was ¥747,485 million (up 10.5%). entries.c23088b69025fdf3: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 by customer location was ¥110,782 million in Japan, ¥232,154 million in the Americas (of which the United States ¥186,994 million), ¥152,371 million in Europe, ¥352,599 million in Asia (of which China ¥228,376 million), and ¥9,925 million in other regions. Overseas sales were handled by local subsidiaries; revenue of FANUC America Corporation was ¥228,485 million and that of FANUC Europe Corporation was ¥162,204 million, each exceeding 10% of consolidated revenue. The customer accounting for 10% or more of consolidated revenue is SHANGHAI-FANUC Robotics CO., LTD., an equity-method affiliate (¥89,639 million, 10.4%).
entries.d8d20dcf1ecffaed: As a comprehensive supplier of factory automation (FA), the company develops, manufactures and sells products based on CNC system technology, including CNC systems (CNC and servo motors), lasers, robots and robomachines (ROBODRILL, ROBOSHOT and ROBOCUT), and provides maintenance services. Because CNCs and servo motors are used in all products, investment decisions are made based on the order, sales and production status of all products rather than specific products, and the securities report omits segment information on the basis that there is a single business segment. The company states that since a control project team was launched in 1955 and it succeeded in developing Japan’s first private-sector NC and servo mechanism in 1956, it has consistently pursued industrial automation, and it sets “strictness and transparency” as its basic philosophy. Under the slogan “one FANUC,” the company states that its 3 business fields of FA, robots and robomachines, together with services, are integrated to provide total solutions. To fulfill its responsibility as a supplier of capital goods, the company has newly built and expanded the Mibu Plant (Mibu-machi, Shimotsuga-gun, Tochigi Prefecture) and the Tsukuba Plant (Chikusei, Ibaraki Prefecture) in addition to its head office plant (Oshino-mura and Yamanakako-mura, Minamitsuru-gun, Yamanashi Prefecture), and has pursued diversification of its production sites.
